verses.1: In all of you, prostitution is heard. And such prostitution exists not only in certain nations, but also among women who belong to their fathers.
verses.2: And you who have been chosen for this task, you also said that it was necessary for this work to be carried out by those among you who were truly qualified to do so.
verses.3: I, for one, when I am away from my body but still with my spirit, already feel like someone who has done such a thing.
verses.4: In the name of our Lord Jesus, together with your spirit and the power of our Lord Jesus.
verses.5: To hand over such a person to Satan’s control, so that his soul may be saved on the day of the Lord.
verses.6: It’s not a good idea for you to do such things. Don’t you know that the entire structure is made of small pieces of glue?
verses.7: They have broken the old bondage, so that there may be a new growth, since we are now free from bondage. For indeed, our suffering has led to Christ’s coming.
verses.8: So that we can enjoy ourselves, not in a state of tension or distress, but in a state of honesty and truthfulness.
verses.9: I have written to you in this letter that you should not associate with prostitutes.
verses.10: Not all those who are prostitutes in this world, nor those who are oppressors and thieves or idolaters, should be allowed to remain in the world after they have broken their promises.
verses.11: Now I write to you that you should not associate with anyone who is called a “brother,” if such person is a prostitute, a thief, an idolater, a liar, or a murderer. Do not even touch such people.
verses.12: Why then should he judge those outside? You yourselves do judge those inside.
verses.13: But does God judge those who are outside? You must get rid of the evil ones among you.
